subject: Order Form — commercial sequencing, invoice entity mapping & tax liability
messages:
From: Evan Perez <evan.perez@lumidata.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@lumidata.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft order form and billing questions

Grace — thanks for the call earlier. Attaching a draft order form for our upcoming pilot (LumiData x Redwood). Before we route to procurement I need to confirm two operational items so our finance team can prepare the PO: 

1) Which legal entity should we list on invoices for the pilot? (we have entities in UK and US)
2) Who is responsible for VAT/GST in the contract? Our AP team needs clarity to set up tax codes.

We'd like net-60 on payment if possible. If Redwood requires a net-30, please let us know and we can escalate.

Attachment: LumiData_OrderForm_Draft_v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

Thanks,
Evan Perez
Head of Finance Ops
LumiData
E: evan.perez@lumidata.com
T: +44 20 5555 1234
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Evan Perez <evan.perez@lumidata.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft order form and billing questions

Evan — thanks, got the draft. A couple of quick clarifications from our side while we pull Legal in: 

- For pilots we typically route invoices to the customer entity specified on the order form. If LumiData prefers the UK entity, we can bill LumiData UK Ltd and issue invoices in GBP.
- Our default position is customer bears VAT/GST. If you'd prefer Redwood to gross-up/withhold, that's an exception we need Sales + Legal sign-off on.
- Net-60 is doable for pilot customers on finance-reviewed deals; I'll confirm with Karthik and Finance.

Karthik — can you propose an invoice-entity map (which entity to bill for pilot vs future expansion) and confirm if any PO routing/issuance constraints?

I'll loop in Kimberly for the redline scope we should expect.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive — Strategic
Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Evan Perez <evan.perez@lumidata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft order form and billing questions — proposed invoice map

Evan / Grace — attaching a quick invoice-entity map for the pilot and potential expansion. High-level proposal: 

- Pilot (Q4) — bill LumiData UK Ltd; currency GBP; invoices monthly.
- Post-pilot (if they convert) — create a second order form tied to LumiData Inc (US) for the North America seat expansion; currency USD.

Notes / asks: 
- If LumiData's AP requires net-60 on the pilot, we can accept net-60 but request a PO reference on each invoice and a single entity to accept the invoices.
- Need to confirm tax treatment: if LumiData wants Redwood to gross-up for VAT, Legal needs to approve language (this impacts pricing).

Attachment: invoice_map_v2.xlsx (Excel, 1 sheet)

Marissa — looping you for pricing cadence / min-commit impact if we accept net-60 and potential tax gross-up.

Thanks,
Karthik
Finance Programs — Redwood Dedicated Sales Ops
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Evan Perez <evan.perez@lumidata.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft order form — legal redlines and tax guidance

Grace / team / Evan — reviewed the draft OF and prepared a short redline with commentary. Summary of the legal position: 

- Net terms: Redwood can accept net-60 for pilot under Finance sign-off, but we need explicit invoicing instructions and a single billing entity on the OF to avoid split-entity invoicing.
- Taxes: Standard is customer-responsible for VAT/GST. If LumiData requests Redwood to remit or gross-up taxes, we will need to increase the list price or insert a tax gross-up clause; Legal will require business approval.
- Minimum commit: the current pilot has no minimum MRR; if we convert to an annual order form with a minimum commit, that will change invoicing cadence and recognition—call out in commercial summary.

Attached redline includes suggested language for: invoice recipient field, PO reference requirement, and a short tax clause. Please review.

Attachment: OF_redline_kp.pdf (PDF, redlines + comments)

Kimberly Park
Contracts Counsel, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

On Wed, Aug 12, 2026 at 09:15 AM Evan Perez <evan.perez@lumidata.com> wrote:
> Thanks Kimberly — appreciate the clarity. A couple of follow-ups: if we accept the tax-responsible position, we need a single country resident entity to appear on the invoice for tax reclaim.
> 
> Also, our finance team requires a sample invoice to map fields into our ERP (PO number, tax id, remit-to). Can Redwood share an example invoice PDF?
> 
> —Evan
From: Evan Perez <evan.perez@lumidata.com>

We can move quickly once we get: 
- final billing entity confirmed on the OF
- sample invoice PDF for ERP mapping
- confirmation on net terms (we prefer net-60)

Subject: Re: Draft order form — next steps and decision log

Evan — appreciate the quick responses and the procurement clarity. To keep momentum, here's the proposed decision log and next steps we will action on Redwood's side: 

Decisions agreed internally: 
- Billing entity for pilot: LumiData UK Ltd (invoices in GBP).
- Net terms: Accepted as net-60 for pilot (Finance approved).
- Tax responsibility: Customer responsible for VAT/GST; LumiData will include VAT ID on PO/invoice for reclaim.
- PO: Redwood requires PO number on every invoice for payment tracking.

Next steps (owner / ETA):
- Redwood Legal (Kimberly) to incorporate the agreed invoice recipient and PO requirement into OF redline — target: 48 hours.
- Redwood Finance (Karthik) to attach sample_invoice_redwood.pdf showing required fields — target: 24 hours.
- LumiData to confirm final remit-to address and provide PO when ready.

Attachments we will share shortly: sample_invoice_redwood.pdf (sample fields), updated OF redline (OF_redline_kp.pdf). Once we have the finalized OF we will circulate for signature.

If that looks correct, Evan can confirm and we'll move to signature queue.
